summary: Frontend-only regression + new-feature testing (answer-style toggle + floating PiP) via preview URL in SERVER mode. All 5 requested scenarios PASS. (1) SERVER mode: provider-server saved; candidate flow returns EXACTLY 3 candidate-bullet-{0,1,2}, no crash overlay, no page errors. (2) Answer style 'complet' (default) → 3 bullets of 20 / 28 / 25 words — full natural sentences with 2-3 bold keywords (e.g. 'piloté plusieurs projets', 'réduit les délais', 'rigueur et communication'), oral amorce 'Alors, j'ai …' on bullet 1. (3) Switched to 'concis' via answer-concis + settings-save-btn → same question regenerated with 3 bullets of 11 / 13 / 14 words, clearly shorter/telegraphic ('Oui, j'ai piloté des projets complexes, équipes mixtes, contraintes fortes.'). Toggle visibly changes generation. (4) Floating button: floating-btn present and visible; window.documentPictureInPicture EXISTS in the test browser (headless Chromium here has it), click did NOT crash and no error toast fired (PiP window opened successfully in the automation). App remains fully interactive after click. (5) Header overflow: scrollWidth == clientWidth at BOTH 1920px (974/974 in center panel, 1920/1920 doc) and 390px (390/390) — buttons wrap cleanly on mobile with no horizontal scroll.
critical_code_review_comments: React console warning during runtime: 'Encountered two children with the same key' fires twice after messages update. selectSession() reassigns m.id via uid() on every load which is fine, but the streaming append in send() also uses uid() — likely the empty state buttons' motion.div keys clash, or MessageBubble children segments in parse.js reuse the same numeric key. Non-blocking but worth chasing (search for map((x,i)=>...key={i}) in MessageBubble / FloatingAnswer / parse rendering).

InterviewConsole.jsx is now ~490 lines with three orthogonal concerns (session/messages, streaming, PiP). Extract usePipWindow() hook — the openFloating logic (styleSheet cloning, pagehide handler, ref bookkeeping) is worth isolating & unit-testable.

openFloating: when a stylesheet has cssRules blocked by CORS the catch falls back to <link>, but the very common case of Tailwind JIT injecting a same-origin sheet works. However the pip window keeps a *snapshot* of CSS at open time — if the user hot-reloads / theme changes the pip stays stale. Consider a MutationObserver on document.styleSheets for parity.

openFloating does not clean up pipWinRef on component unmount (only on the pip's own pagehide). If the parent component unmounts while the pip is open, ref leaks. Add a useEffect cleanup calling pipWinRef.current?.close().

MODE_REMINDER.CANDIDAT_COMPLET says 'IGNORE la limite de 12 mots' but the base SYSTEM_PROMPT still enforces C1 ≤12 mots as priority 2 (higher than T1–T5). The model complied here, but this is a prompt-priority contradiction — bullet 2 was 28 words. Consider explicitly overriding C1 in the CONSIGNE ('En mode COMPLET, C1 est suspendu.') so the guarantee is robust across models.

answerStyle default is 'complet' in api.getSettings but SettingsPanel initial useState is 'complet' too — good. However, sessions created before this feature will have no answerStyle key; getSettings backfills it (line 116). Verified via manual localStorage prime — safe.

FloatingAnswer.jsx renders bullets with numeric list index (1./2./3.) which duplicates the numbering the parser already outputs — visually fine but semantically doubled if bullets are parsed with leading numbers.
test_credentials: None required — SERVER mode uses server-side key.
seed_data_creation: localStorage['settings'] preset to {provider:'server', answerStyle:'complet'} before load to skip first-run modal.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Server mode + answer style toggle + floating PiP all verified. In headless Chromium the preview environment DOES expose window.documentPictureInPicture, so the graceful-fallback toast branch was NOT exercised — if you want to validate the toast, spoof it with `delete window.documentPictureInPicture` before click. Complet bullets: 20/28/25 words. Concis bullets: 11/13/14 words. Non-blocking: React duplicate-key warnings appear when messages array grows; hunt in MessageBubble/parse.js segments map.
